name: phil/reviews-bundle
description: Let members review a product, game or place: ratings by criteria, moderation, helpfulness votes and a fair Bayesian average, with verified-buyer marks.

suggest.doctrine/orm: For the tables added to the schema the ORM generates
suggest.phil/moderation-bundle: To report reviews in the one queue of the moderation, and withdraw them under the published criteria
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: For the reviews, votes and responses in the export and the erasure of a member's data
suggest.phil/rate-limit-bundle: To limit the review form and the votes through the rules named in the configuration
suggest.phil/spam-protection-bundle: To hold the review form to a honeypot, a single-use token, a proof of work and content rules
suggest.phil/structured-data: For the schema.org AggregateRating of a subject whose reviews were all collected on the site
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipes Rating, Button, Badge, Input, Checkbox and Textarea the pages draw, through the Symfony UX Toolkit
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: To serve the Stimulus controller of the votes without a build step
suggest.symfony/routing: For the pages of the reviews
suggest.symfony/security-core: To name the current member from the authenticated user, and decide who responds
suggest.symfony/security-csrf: For the forms of the pages
suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: For the pages of the reviews
suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: For the recipes of the kit the pages draw
